changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO person_notifications (person_id, notifications) SELECT DISTINCT office.person_id, 'NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_REMAINING_VACATION_DAYS_EXPIRED_MANAGEMENT_ALL' FROM person_permissions office WHERE office.permissions = 'OFFICE' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM person_notifications existing WHERE existing.person_id = office.person_id AND existing.notifications = 'NOTIFICATION_EMAIL_REMAINING_VACATION_DAYS_EXPIRED_MANAGEMENT_ALL' );
